meaning.th: ~ ไปเสียแล้ว (เสียดาย)

quiz.ja: 二人は、どこから来た人ですか。

explain.vi: Họ là người giàu từ Tokyo đến (câu 2).
explain.zh-Hans: 从东京来的有钱人（第2句）。
explain.zh-Hant: 從東京來的有錢人（第2句）。
explain.th: คนรวยจากโตเกียว (2)

quiz.ja: 犬が死んだとき、二人は何の話ばかりしましたか。

explain.th: พูดแต่เรื่องเงิน (10–12)

quiz.ja: 店の名前は何でしたか。

explain.vi: Họ tưởng vì quán đông khách (câu 33).
explain.en: They thought it was a popular place (line 33).
explain.th: คิดว่าเพราะร้านดัง (33)

quiz.ja: 二人は、さいふやめがねをどうしましたか。

explain.my: မီးခံသေတ္တာထဲ ထည့်တယ် (၅၂)။

jaFurigana.surface: は、さいふやめがねをどうしましたか。

sentences.ja: 二人のわかい男が、山の奥を歩いていました。
sentences.romaji: Futari no wakai otoko ga, yama no oku o aruiteimashita.

translations.vi: Hai chàng trai trẻ đang đi sâu trong núi.
translations.en: Two young men were walking deep in the mountains.
translations.zh-Hans: 两个年轻男人在深山里走着。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩個年輕男人在深山裡走著。
translations.ko: 두 젊은 남자가 산속 깊이 걷고 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Dalawang binata ang naglalakad sa kailaliman ng bundok.
translations.ne: दुई जना युवा पहाडको भित्री भागमा हिँडिरहेका थिए।
translations.id: Dua pemuda berjalan jauh di dalam gunung.
translations.pt: Dois rapazes andavam no fundo das montanhas.
translations.my: လူငယ် နှစ်ယောက် တောင်ထဲ နက်နက် လျှောက်နေတယ်။
translations.th: ชายหนุ่มสองคนเดินอยู่ในป่าเขาลึก
translations.si: තරුණ පිරිමි දෙන්නෙක් කඳුකරයේ ඈත ඇතුළට ඇවිදගෙන ගියා.

grammarNote.vi: 奥 = phía sâu bên trong.
grammarNote.en: 奥 = the depths, interior.
grammarNote.th: ส่วนลึก
grammarNote.si: 奥 = ඈත ඇතුළ.

sentences.ja: 二人とも、東京から来た、お金持ちの男です。
sentences.romaji: Futari tomo, toukyou kara kita, okanemochi no otoko desu.

translations.vi: Cả hai đều là những anh nhà giàu từ Tokyo đến.
translations.en: Both were rich men from Tokyo.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人都是从东京来的有钱人。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人都是從東京來的有錢人。
translations.ko: 두 사람 모두 도쿄에서 온 부자였습니다.
translations.tl: Pareho silang mayamang lalaki mula Tokyo.
translations.ne: दुवै टोकियोबाट आएका धनी थिए।
translations.id: Keduanya orang kaya dari Tokyo.
translations.pt: Os dois eram ricos, vindos de Tóquio.
translations.th: ทั้งสองเป็นคนรวยมาจากโตเกียว
translations.si: දෙන්නම ටෝකියෝවල ඉඳලා ආපු පොහොසත් අය.

grammarNote.vi: お金持ち = người giàu. 〜とも = cả ~.
grammarNote.en: お金持ち = rich person. 〜とも = both.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: お金持ち＝有钱人。〜とも＝都。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: お金持ち＝有錢人。〜とも＝都。
grammarNote.th: คนรวย ทั้งคู่
grammarNote.si: お金持ち = පොහොසතා. 〜とも = දෙන්නම.

sentences.ja: かたには、ぴかぴかの鉄砲をかついでいます。
sentences.romaji: Kata ni wa, pikapika no teppou o katsuideimasu.

translations.vi: Trên vai họ vác những khẩu súng sáng bóng.
translations.en: On their shoulders they carried shiny guns.
translations.zh-Hans: 肩上扛着锃亮的猎枪。
translations.zh-Hant: 肩上扛著鋥亮的獵槍。
translations.ko: 어깨에는 번쩍번쩍한 총을 메고 있습니다.
translations.tl: May pasan silang makikintab na baril.
translations.ne: काँधमा टल्कने बन्दुक बोकेका थिए।
translations.id: Di bahu mereka tersandang senapan mengilap.
translations.pt: Nos ombros levavam espingardas reluzentes.
translations.my: ပခုံးပေါ်မှာ တောက်ပြောင်တဲ့ သေနတ် ထမ်းထားတယ်။
translations.th: บนบ่าแบกปืนเงาวับ
translations.si: උරහිස්වල දිලිසෙන තුවක්කු එල්ලගෙන.

grammarNote.vi: 鉄砲 = súng. かつぐ = vác.
grammarNote.en: 鉄砲 = gun. かつぐ = shoulder.
grammarNote.my: သေနတ်။ ထမ်း။
grammarNote.th: ปืน แบก
grammarNote.si: 鉄砲 = තුවක්කුව. かつぐ = උරහිසේ තියාගන්නවා.

sentences.ja: 後ろには、白くて大きな犬が二ひき、ついてきています。

furigana.surface: ひき、ついてきています。

sentences.romaji: Ushiro ni wa, shirokute ookina inu ga nihiki, tsuitekiteimasu.

translations.vi: Phía sau là hai con chó trắng to lớn theo cùng.
translations.en: Behind them followed two big white dogs.
translations.zh-Hans: 后面跟着两条又白又大的狗。
translations.zh-Hant: 後面跟著兩條又白又大的狗。
translations.ko: 뒤에는 크고 하얀 개 두 마리가 따라오고 있습니다.
translations.tl: Sa likod nila ay may dalawang malaking puting aso.
translations.ne: पछाडि दुईवटा ठूला सेता कुकुर पछ्याउँदै थिए।
translations.id: Di belakang mengikuti dua anjing putih besar.
translations.pt: Atrás vinham dois cachorros grandes e brancos.
translations.my: နောက်မှာ အဖြူရောင် ခွေးကြီး နှစ်ကောင် လိုက်လာတယ်။
translations.th: ข้างหลังมีสุนัขขาวตัวใหญ่สองตัวตามมา
translations.si: පිටිපස්සෙන් ලොකු සුදු බල්ලෝ දෙන්නෙක් එනවා.

grammarNote.vi: ついてくる = đi theo.
grammarNote.en: ついてくる = follow along.
grammarNote.th: ตามมา
grammarNote.si: ついてくる = පස්සෙන් එනවා.

sentences.ja: 「このへんの山は、まったくだめだね。鳥も動物も、一ぴきもいない。」
sentences.romaji: “Kono hen no yama wa, mattaku dame da ne. Tori mo doubutsu mo, ippiki mo inai.”

translations.vi: "Núi vùng này dở thật. Chẳng có lấy một con chim hay con thú nào."
translations.en: "The mountains around here are hopeless. Not a single bird or beast."
translations.zh-Hans: “这一带的山真不行。一只鸟一只野兽都没有。”
translations.zh-Hant: “這一帶的山真不行。一隻鳥一隻野獸都沒有。”
translations.ko: "이 근처 산은 정말 형편없군. 새도 짐승도 한 마리도 없어."
translations.tl: "Walang kuwenta ang bundok dito. Walang kahit isang ibon o hayop."
translations.ne: "यहाँको पहाड बेकार रहेछ। चरा, जनावर एउटा पनि छैन।"
translations.id: "Gunung di sini payah. Tak ada seekor burung atau binatang pun."
translations.pt: "As montanhas daqui são péssimas. Nem um pássaro, nem um bicho."
translations.my: "ဒီနားက တောင်တွေ လုံးဝ မကောင်းဘူး။ ငှက်ရော တိရစ္ဆာန်ရော တစ်ကောင်မှ မရှိဘူး။"
translations.th: "ภูเขาแถวนี้แย่จริง ๆ ไม่มีนกหรือสัตว์สักตัว"
translations.si: "මේ පළාතේ කඳු නම් කිසිම වැඩක් නැහැ. කුරුල්ලෙක්වත් සතෙක්වත් එකෙක්වත් නැහැ."

grammarNote.vi: まったく = hoàn toàn. 〜も〜ない = không ~ nào cả.
grammarNote.en: まったく = utterly. 〜も〜ない = not even ~.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: まったく＝完全。〜も〜ない＝连……都没有。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: まったく＝完全。〜も〜ない＝連……都沒有。
grammarNote.th: เลย ไม่มีสัก ~
grammarNote.si: まったく = කොහෙත්ම. 〜も〜ない = ~ වත් නැහැ.

sentences.ja: 「なんでもいいから、早くズドンと、うってみたいなあ。」

furigana.surface: くズドンと、うってみたいなあ。」

sentences.romaji: “Nan demo ii kara, hayaku zudon to, uttemitai naa.”

translations.vi: "Gì cũng được, tôi muốn bắn một phát 'đoàng' cho sướng tay."
translations.en: "Anything will do—I just want to fire off a big bang!"
translations.zh-Hans: “什么都行，真想‘砰’地打一枪。”
translations.zh-Hant: “什麼都行，真想‘砰’地打一槍。”
translations.ko: "아무거나 좋으니 빨리 탕 하고 쏴 보고 싶다."
translations.tl: "Kahit ano, gusto ko nang magpaputok!"
translations.ne: "जे भए पनि, छिटो ढ्याङ्ङ हानेर हेर्न मन छ।"
translations.id: "Apa saja boleh, aku ingin cepat-cepat menembak, dor!"
translations.pt: "Qualquer coisa serve, quero logo dar um tiro, bum!"
translations.my: "ဘာဖြစ်ဖြစ်၊ ဒိုင်းခနဲ မြန်မြန် ပစ်ကြည့်ချင်တယ်။"
translations.th: "อะไรก็ได้ อยากยิงปังสักนัด"
translations.si: "මොකක් වුණත් කමක් නැහැ, ඉක්මනට 'ඩුම්' ගාලා වෙඩි තියලා බලන්න ඕනේ."

grammarNote.vi: 〜てみたい = muốn thử ~. ズドン = đoàng (tiếng súng).
grammarNote.en: 〜てみたい = want to try ~. ズドン = bang.
grammarNote.th: อยากลอง ~ ปัง
grammarNote.si: 〜てみたい = ~ කරලා බලන්න ඕනේ. ズドン = ඩුම් (වෙඩි සද්දය).

sentences.ja: 山の奥は、とても深くて、道案内の人も、どこかへ行ってしまいました。
sentences.romaji: Yama no oku wa, totemo fukakute, michiannai no hito mo, doko ka e itteshimaimashita.

translations.vi: Rừng núi rất sâu, người dẫn đường cũng đã đi đâu mất.
translations.en: The mountains were so deep that even their guide had wandered off.
translations.zh-Hans: 山里很深，连向导也不知去哪儿了。
translations.zh-Hant: 山裡很深，連嚮導也不知去哪兒了。
translations.ko: 산속이 너무 깊어서 길 안내인도 어디론가 가 버렸습니다.
translations.tl: Napakalalim ng bundok; pati ang gabay nila ay nawala.
translations.ne: पहाड धेरै गहिरो थियो, बाटो देखाउने मान्छे पनि कतै गयो।
translations.id: Gunungnya sangat dalam, pemandu jalan pun entah ke mana.
translations.pt: A mata era tão fundo que até o guia sumiu.
translations.my: တောင်က အရမ်း နက်ပြီး လမ်းပြလည်း ဘယ်ရောက်သွားမှန်း မသိဘူး။
translations.th: ป่าเขาลึกมาก คนนำทางก็หายไปไหนไม่รู้
translations.si: කඳුකරය හරිම ගැඹුරු නිසා, මඟ පෙන්නපු කෙනත් කොහෙටද ගිහින්.

grammarNote.vi: 道案内 = người dẫn đường.
grammarNote.en: 道案内 = guide.
grammarNote.th: คนนำทาง
grammarNote.si: 道案内 = මඟ පෙන්වන්නා.

sentences.ja: そのとき、二ひきの犬が、急にたおれてしまいました。

furigana.surface: にたおれてしまいました。

sentences.romaji: Sono toki, nihiki no inu ga, kyuu ni taoreteshimaimashita.

translations.vi: Đúng lúc đó, hai con chó bỗng ngã gục.
translations.en: Just then, the two dogs suddenly collapsed.
translations.zh-Hans: 就在这时，两条狗突然倒下了。
translations.zh-Hant: 就在這時，兩條狗突然倒下了。
translations.ko: 그때 개 두 마리가 갑자기 쓰러지고 말았습니다.
translations.tl: Noon din, biglang bumagsak ang dalawang aso.
translations.ne: त्यही बेला दुवै कुकुर अचानक ढले।
translations.id: Saat itu, kedua anjing tiba-tiba roboh.
translations.pt: Nisso, os dois cachorros caíram de repente.
translations.my: အဲဒီအချိန်မှာ ခွေးနှစ်ကောင် ရုတ်တရက် လဲကျသွားတယ်။
translations.th: ทันใดนั้น สุนัขสองตัวก็ล้มลง
translations.si: එතකොට, බල්ලෝ දෙන්නා එකපාරටම බිම වැටුණා.

grammarNote.vi: たおれる = ngã gục.
grammarNote.en: たおれる = collapse.
grammarNote.th: ล้ม
grammarNote.si: たおれる = ඇදගෙන වැටෙනවා.

sentences.ja: しばらくうなって、それから、口からあわをはいて、死んでしまいました。

furigana.surface: しばらくうなって、それから、

sentences.romaji: Shibaraku unatte, sorekara, kuchi kara awa o haite, shindeshimaimashita.

translations.vi: Chúng rên một lúc, rồi sùi bọt mép mà chết.
translations.en: They groaned a while, foamed at the mouth, and died.
translations.zh-Hans: 呻吟了一会儿，然后口吐白沫死了。
translations.zh-Hant: 呻吟了一會兒，然後口吐白沫死了。
translations.ko: 한동안 신음하더니 입에서 거품을 토하고 죽어 버렸습니다.
translations.tl: Umungol sila, bumula ang bibig, at namatay.
translations.ne: केही बेर गुर्राएर मुखबाट फिँज निकाल्दै मरे।
translations.id: Mereka mengerang sebentar, berbusa mulutnya, lalu mati.
translations.pt: Gemeram um pouco, espumaram pela boca e morreram.
translations.my: ခဏ ညည်းပြီး ပါးစပ်က အမြှုပ်ထွက်ပြီး သေသွားတယ်။
translations.th: ครางอยู่สักพัก น้ำลายฟูมปากแล้วก็ตาย
translations.si: ටික වෙලාවක් කෙඳිරිගාලා, ඊට පස්සේ කටින් පෙණ දාලා මැරිලා ගියා.

grammarNote.vi: あわ = bọt. 死ぬ = chết.
grammarNote.en: あわ = foam. 死ぬ = die.
grammarNote.th: ฟอง ตาย
grammarNote.si: あわ = පෙණ. 死ぬ = මැරෙනවා.

sentences.ja: 「ああ、二千四百円の犬が、だめになってしまった。」

furigana.reading: にせんよんひゃくえん

furigana.surface: が、だめになってしまった。」

sentences.romaji: “Aa, nisen'yonhyakuen no inu ga, dame ni natteshimatta.”

translations.vi: "Ôi, con chó 2.400 yên của tôi tiêu rồi."
translations.en: "Oh, my 2,400-yen dog is ruined."
translations.zh-Hans: “唉，我那条两千四百日元的狗完了。”
translations.zh-Hant: “唉，我那條兩千四百日元的狗完了。”

translations.tl: "Naku, nasayang ang 2,400-yen kong aso."
translations.ne: "ओहो, मेरो २४०० येनको कुकुर गयो।"
translations.id: "Aduh, anjingku seharga 2.400 yen mati."
translations.pt: "Ah, meu cachorro de 2.400 ienes se foi."
translations.th: "โธ่ หมา 2,400 เยนของฉันตายเสียแล้ว"

sentences.ja: 「ぼくの犬は、二千八百円だったんだぞ。」

furigana.reading: にせんはっぴゃくえん

sentences.romaji: “Boku no inu wa, nisenhappyakuen datta n da zo.”

translations.vi: "Chó của tôi những 2.800 yên đấy."
translations.en: "Mine cost 2,800 yen, you know."
translations.zh-Hans: “我的狗可是两千八百日元的。”
translations.zh-Hant: “我的狗可是兩千八百日元的。”
translations.ko: "내 개는 2,800엔이었다고."
translations.tl: "Ang aso ko ay 2,800 yen."

translations.pt: "O meu custou 2.800 ienes!"
translations.th: "หมาฉันตั้ง 2,800 เยนนะ"
translations.si: "මගේ බල්ලා යෙන් දෙදහස් අටසීයයි, දන්නවද."

grammarNote.th: (เน้น)

sentences.ja: 二人は、犬が死んだことより、お金のことばかり話しました。
sentences.romaji: Futari wa, inu ga shinda koto yori, okane no koto bakari hanashimashita.

translations.vi: Hai người không nói chuyện chó chết, mà chỉ toàn nói chuyện tiền.
translations.en: Rather than the dogs' deaths, the two talked only about money.
translations.zh-Hans: 比起狗死了，两人光谈钱的事。
translations.zh-Hant: 比起狗死了，兩人光談錢的事。
translations.ko: 두 사람은 개가 죽은 것보다 돈 이야기만 했습니다.
translations.tl: Mas pera pa ang pinag-usapan nila kaysa sa namatay na aso.
translations.ne: दुवैले कुकुर मरेको भन्दा पैसाको कुरा मात्र गरे।
translations.id: Keduanya lebih membicarakan uang daripada kematian anjing.
translations.pt: Mais que a morte dos cães, falavam só de dinheiro.
translations.my: နှစ်ယောက်လုံး ခွေးသေတာထက် ပိုက်ဆံအကြောင်းပဲ ပြောတယ်။
translations.th: สองคนพูดแต่เรื่องเงิน มากกว่าเรื่องหมาตาย
translations.si: දෙන්නා බල්ලෝ මැරුණ එකට වඩා, සල්ලි ගැන විතරයි කතා කළේ.

grammarNote.vi: 〜より = hơn là ~. 〜ばかり = chỉ toàn ~.
grammarNote.en: 〜より = rather than ~. 〜ばかり = nothing but ~.
grammarNote.th: มากกว่า ~ แต่ ~
grammarNote.si: 〜より = ~ ට වඩා. 〜ばかり = ~ ම විතරයි.

sentences.ja: 風がどうとふいて、草はざわざわ、木の葉はかさかさ鳴りました。
sentences.romaji: Kaze ga dou to fuite, kusa wa zawazawa, konoha wa kasakasa narimashita.

translations.vi: Gió thổi ào ào, cỏ xào xạc, lá cây lao xao.
translations.en: The wind blew hard; the grass rustled, the leaves rattled.
translations.zh-Hans: 风呼呼地吹，草沙沙作响，树叶哗哗地响。
translations.zh-Hant: 風呼呼地吹，草沙沙作響，樹葉嘩嘩地響。
translations.ko: 바람이 휭 불고, 풀은 사각사각, 나뭇잎은 바스락바스락 울렸습니다.
translations.tl: Humihip ang hangin; kumaluskos ang damo at dahon.
translations.ne: हावा सुसाउँदै चल्यो, घाँस सरसर, पात खसखस गरे।
translations.id: Angin bertiup kencang, rumput berdesir, daun bergemerisik.
translations.pt: O vento soprou forte; o capim farfalhou, as folhas chiaram.
translations.my: လေ ဝုန်းခနဲ တိုက်ပြီး မြက်တွေ တရှဲရှဲ၊ သစ်ရွက်တွေ တဖျပ်ဖျပ် မြည်တယ်။
translations.th: ลมพัดวู่ หญ้าไหวซู่ซ่า ใบไม้ดังกรอบแกรบ
translations.si: සුළඟ හූ ගාලා හැමුවා, තණකොළ සර සර ගාලා, ගස් කොළ කර කර ගාලා සද්ද කළා.

grammarNote.vi: Câu lặp nổi tiếng của nguyên tác. ざわざわ/かさかさ = tiếng xào xạc.
grammarNote.en: A famous refrain from the original. ざわざわ/かさかさ = rustling sounds.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 原作中有名的反复句。ざわざわ/かさかさ＝沙沙声。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 原作中有名的反覆句。ざわざわ/かさかさ＝沙沙聲。
grammarNote.my: မူရင်း နာမည်ကြီး ထပ်ကျော့စာ။
grammarNote.th: ประโยคซ้ำอันโด่งดังของต้นฉบับ
grammarNote.si: මුල් කතාවේ ප්‍රසිද්ධ පුනරාවර්තන පේළිය. ざわざわ/かさかさ = සරසර සද්ද.

sentences.ja: 「ぼくは、もう帰ろうと思う。おなかもすいたし、寒くなってきた。」
sentences.romaji: “Boku wa, mou kaerou to omou. Onaka mo suita shi, samuku nattekita.”

translations.vi: "Tôi muốn về rồi. Vừa đói, trời lại lạnh dần."
translations.en: "I think I'll head back. I'm hungry, and it's getting cold."
translations.zh-Hans: “我想回去了。肚子饿了，天也冷起来了。”
translations.zh-Hant: “我想回去了。肚子餓了，天也冷起來了。”
translations.ko: "난 이제 돌아가려고. 배도 고프고 추워졌어."
translations.tl: "Uuwi na ako. Gutom na ako at lumalamig pa."
translations.ne: "म अब फर्कन्छु। भोक पनि लाग्यो, चिसो पनि भयो।"
translations.id: "Aku mau pulang. Lapar, dan mulai dingin."
translations.pt: "Acho que vou voltar. Estou com fome e esfriou."
translations.th: "ฉันจะกลับแล้ว หิวด้วย หนาวขึ้นด้วย"
translations.si: "මම නම් ආපහු යන්න හිතනවා. බඩත් ගිනියි, සීතලත් වැඩි වෙනවා."

grammarNote.vi: 〜し = vừa ~ (nêu lý do). 〜てくる = dần ~.
grammarNote.en: 〜し = and also (listing reasons). 〜てくる = become gradually.
grammarNote.th: ทั้ง ~ ค่อย ๆ ~
grammarNote.si: 〜し = ~ ත් (හේතු ලැයිස්තුව). 〜てくる = ක්‍රමයෙන් ~ වෙනවා.

sentences.ja: 「そうだね。帰りに、町で鳥を買っていこう。」
sentences.romaji: “Sou da ne. Kaeri ni, machi de tori o katteikou.”

translations.vi: "Ừ. Lúc về, mua chim ở phố mang về vậy."
translations.en: "Right. On the way, let's buy some birds in town."
translations.zh-Hans: “是啊。回去时在镇上买点鸟吧。”
translations.zh-Hant: “是啊。回去時在鎮上買點鳥吧。”
translations.ko: "그래. 돌아가는 길에 마을에서 새를 사 가자."
translations.tl: "Sige. Pauwi, bumili tayo ng ibon sa bayan."
translations.ne: "हो। फर्कँदा सहरमा चरा किनेर जाऔँ।"
translations.id: "Iya. Pulangnya, beli burung di kota saja."
translations.pt: "Certo. Na volta, compramos aves na cidade."
translations.my: "ဟုတ်တယ်။ ပြန်ရင် မြို့မှာ ငှက် ဝယ်သွားမယ်။"
translations.th: "ใช่ ขากลับซื้อนกในเมืองไปละกัน"
translations.si: "ඔව්. යන ගමන් නගරෙන් කුරුල්ලෝ ටිකක් ගෙනියමු."

grammarNote.vi: 帰りに = trên đường về.
grammarNote.en: 帰りに = on the way back.
grammarNote.th: ขากลับ
grammarNote.si: 帰りに = ආපහු යන ගමන්.

sentences.ja: ところが、どっちへ行けば帰れるのか、もうわかりません。

furigana.surface: れるのか、もうわかりません。

sentences.romaji: Tokoroga, dotchi e ikeba kaereru no ka, mou wakarimasen.

translations.vi: Thế nhưng, đi hướng nào mới về được, họ không còn biết nữa.
translations.en: But they no longer knew which way led home.
translations.zh-Hans: 可是，已经不知道该往哪儿走才能回去了。
translations.zh-Hant: 可是，已經不知道該往哪兒走才能回去了。
translations.ko: 그런데 어느 쪽으로 가야 돌아갈 수 있는지 이제 알 수 없었습니다.
translations.tl: Pero hindi na nila alam kung saan ang daan pauwi.
translations.ne: तर कता गए फर्किन सकिन्छ, थाहा भएन।
translations.id: Namun mereka tak tahu lagi arah pulang.
translations.pt: Mas já não sabiam por onde voltar.
translations.my: ဒါပေမဲ့ ဘယ်ဘက် သွားရင် ပြန်ရောက်မလဲ မသိတော့ဘူး။
translations.th: แต่ไม่รู้แล้วว่าไปทางไหนจะกลับได้
translations.si: ඒත්, කොයි පැත්තට ගියොත්ද ගෙදර යන්න පුළුවන් කියලා දැන් තේරෙන්නේ නැහැ.

grammarNote.th: ถ้า ~ (คำถาม)

translations.zh-Hant: 這時，偶然回頭一看，立著一棟氣派的西式房子。
translations.ko: 그때 문득 뒤를 보니 훌륭한 서양식 집이 한 채 서 있었습니다.

translations.ne: त्यही बेला पछाडि हेर्दा एउटा भव्य पश्चिमी घर उभिएको थियो।
translations.id: Saat menoleh, berdiri sebuah rumah bergaya Barat yang megah.
translations.pt: Então, olhando para trás, viram uma bela casa ocidental.
translations.my: အဲဒီအချိန် နောက်ကို ကြည့်လိုက်တော့ ခန့်ညားတဲ့ အနောက်တိုင်း အိမ်တစ်လုံး ရှိတယ်။

translations.si: එතකොට අහම්බෙන් පිටිපස්ස බැලුවාම, ලස්සන බටහිර විලාසිතාවේ ගෙයක් තිබුණා.

grammarNote.en: りっぱ = splendid. 西洋 = Western.
grammarNote.th: หรูหรา ตะวันตก

translations.tl: Sa pasukan ay may karatulang ganito.

translations.id: Di pintu masuk tergantung papan seperti ini.
translations.pt: Na entrada havia uma placa assim.
translations.my: ဝင်ပေါက်မှာ ဒီလို ဆိုင်းဘုတ် ချိတ်ထားတယ်။
translations.th: ที่ทางเข้ามีป้ายแขวนอยู่อย่างนี้
translations.si: දොරටුවේ මෙහෙම පුවරුවක් එල්ලලා තිබුණා.

translations.zh-Hant: “喂，正好。這是餐館。進去吧？”
translations.ko: "이봐, 마침 잘됐다. 여긴 레스토랑이야. 들어가자."
translations.tl: "Uy, tamang-tama. Restawran ito. Pasok tayo!"
translations.ne: "ए, ठीक भयो। यो रेस्टुरेन्ट हो। पसौँ न।"
translations.id: "Hei, pas sekali. Ini restoran. Ayo masuk!"
translations.pt: "Ei, que ótimo. É um restaurante. Vamos entrar!"
translations.th: "เฮ้ พอดีเลย เป็นร้านอาหาร เข้าไปกันเถอะ"
translations.si: "ඒයි, හරියටම හොඳයි. මේක අවන්හලක්. යමු ඇතුළට!"

grammarNote.vi: 〜ようじゃないか = chẳng phải nên ~ sao (rủ rê).
grammarNote.en: 〜ようじゃないか = why don't we ~? (invitation).
grammarNote.th: ~ กันไหม
grammarNote.si: 〜ようじゃないか = ~ කරමු නේද? (ආරාධනාව).

sentences.ja: 「こんな山の中に、おかしいな。でも、何か食べられるだろう。」
sentences.romaji: “Konna yama no naka ni, okashii na. Demo, nani ka taberarerudarou.”

translations.vi: "Giữa núi thế này mà có, lạ nhỉ. Nhưng chắc là ăn được gì đó."
translations.en: "Strange, out here in the mountains. But we can probably eat something."
translations.zh-Hans: “这种山里，真奇怪。不过总能吃点东西吧。”
translations.zh-Hant: “這種山裡，真奇怪。不過總能吃點東西吧。”
translations.ko: "이런 산속에 이상하네. 그래도 뭔가 먹을 수 있겠지."
translations.tl: "Kakaiba, sa gitna ng bundok. Pero baka may makain."
translations.ne: "यस्तो पहाडमा, अनौठो। तर केही खान पाइएला।"
translations.id: "Aneh, di gunung begini. Tapi mungkin bisa makan sesuatu."
translations.pt: "Estranho, aqui no mato. Mas deve dar para comer algo."
translations.my: "ဒီလို တောင်ထဲမှာ ထူးဆန်းတယ်။ ဒါပေမဲ့ တစ်ခုခု စားလို့ ရမှာပါ။"
translations.th: "ในป่าแบบนี้แปลกจัง แต่คงได้กินอะไรสักอย่าง"
translations.si: "මෙහෙම කඳු මැද? පුදුමයි. ඒත් මොනවා හරි කන්න හම්බ වෙයි."

grammarNote.vi: おかしい = kỳ lạ. 〜だろう = chắc ~.
grammarNote.en: おかしい = strange. 〜だろう = probably ~.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: おかしい＝奇怪。〜だろう＝大概……。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: おかしい＝奇怪。〜だろう＝大概……。
grammarNote.th: แปลก คง ~
grammarNote.si: おかしい = අමුතුයි. 〜だろう = ~ වෙයි.

sentences.ja: げんかんの白いガラスの戸には、金の字で、こう書いてありました。
sentences.romaji: Genkan no shiroi garasu no to ni wa, kinnoji de, kou kaitearimashita.

translations.vi: Trên cánh cửa kính trắng ở tiền sảnh có viết chữ vàng như sau.
translations.en: On the white glass door of the entrance, this was written in gold letters.
translations.zh-Hans: 门厅的白玻璃门上，用金字这样写着。
translations.zh-Hant: 門廳的白玻璃門上，用金字這樣寫著。
translations.ko: 현관의 하얀 유리문에는 금색 글자로 이렇게 쓰여 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Sa puting salaming pinto, nakasulat sa gintong letra ang ganito.
translations.ne: मूलढोकाको सेतो सिसाको ढोकामा सुनौला अक्षरले यसो लेखिएको थियो।
translations.id: Di pintu kaca putih depan tertulis dengan huruf emas begini.
translations.pt: Na porta de vidro branco havia escrito em letras douradas.
translations.th: ที่ประตูกระจกสีขาวหน้าบ้าน มีตัวอักษรสีทองเขียนว่า
translations.si: දොරටුවේ සුදු වීදුරු දොරේ රන් අකුරෙන් මෙහෙම ලියලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 〜てある = đã được ~ (trạng thái).
grammarNote.en: 〜てある = has been ~ (state).
grammarNote.th: เขียนไว้
grammarNote.si: 〜てある = ~ කරලා තියෙනවා (තත්ත්වය).

sentences.ja: 「どなたも、どうか、お入りください。決してごえんりょはいりません。」

furigana.surface: してごえんりょはいりません。」

sentences.romaji: “Donata mo, dou ka, ohairikudasai. Kesshite goenryo wa irimasen.”

translations.vi: "Xin mời quý khách vào. Xin đừng ngại ngần gì cả."
translations.en: "Everyone, please come in. Do not hold back at all."
translations.zh-Hans: “各位，请进。千万不要客气。”
translations.zh-Hant: “各位，請進。千萬不要客氣。”
translations.ko: "누구든 부디 들어오십시오. 절대 사양하지 마십시오."
translations.tl: "Pumasok po ang lahat. Huwag po kayong mahiya."
translations.ne: "जो कोही पनि भित्र आउनुहोस्। पटक्कै सङ्कोच नमान्नुहोस्।"
translations.id: "Siapa pun, silakan masuk. Jangan sungkan sedikit pun."
translations.pt: "Todos, por favor, entrem. Não façam cerimônia."
translations.my: "ဘယ်သူမဆို ဝင်ပါ။ လုံးဝ အားမနာပါနဲ့။"
translations.th: "เชิญทุกท่านเข้ามา ไม่ต้องเกรงใจเลย"
translations.si: "ඕනෑම කෙනෙක්, කරුණාකර ඇතුළට එන්න. කිසිසේත් පැකිළෙන්න එපා."

grammarNote.vi: 決して〜ない = tuyệt đối không ~. えんりょ = ngại ngùng.
grammarNote.en: 決して〜ない = never ~. えんりょ = hesitation.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 決して〜ない＝绝不……。えんりょ＝客气。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 決して〜ない＝絕不……。えんりょ＝客氣。
grammarNote.th: ไม่ ~ เลย เกรงใจ
grammarNote.si: 決して〜ない = කිසිසේත් ~ නැහැ. えんりょ = පැකිළීම.

sentences.ja: 「ありがたいね。ただで食べさせてくれるらしいぞ。」

furigana.surface: べさせてくれるらしいぞ。」

sentences.romaji: “Arigatai ne. Tada de tabesasetekurerurashii zo.”

translations.vi: "Hay quá. Hình như cho ăn miễn phí đấy."
translations.en: "How nice. Looks like they'll feed us for free!"
translations.zh-Hans: “太好了。好像是免费请吃呢。”
translations.zh-Hant: “太好了。好像是免費請吃呢。”
translations.ko: "고맙군. 공짜로 먹여 주는 모양이야."
translations.tl: "Ang galing. Mukhang libre ang pagkain!"
translations.ne: "धन्य। सित्तैमा खुवाउने जस्तो छ।"
translations.id: "Asyik. Sepertinya makan gratis!"
translations.pt: "Que bom. Parece que é de graça!"
translations.th: "ดีจัง ดูเหมือนจะให้กินฟรีนะ"
translations.si: "මාර වාසනාව. නිකන්ම කන්න දෙනවා වගේ!"

grammarNote.vi: ただで = miễn phí. 〜らしい = có vẻ ~.
grammarNote.en: ただで = for free. 〜らしい = seems ~.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: ただで＝免费。〜らしい＝好像……。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: ただで＝免費。〜らしい＝好像……。
grammarNote.th: ฟรี ดูเหมือน ~
grammarNote.si: ただで = නිකන්ම. 〜らしい = වගේ.

sentences.ja: 二人が中へ入ると、すぐにまた、戸がありました。
sentences.romaji: Futari ga naka e hairu to, sugu ni mata, to ga arimashita.

translations.vi: Vừa vào trong, lại thấy ngay một cánh cửa nữa.
translations.en: As soon as they went in, there was another door.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人一进去，马上又有一扇门。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人一進去，馬上又有一扇門。
translations.ko: 두 사람이 안으로 들어가자 곧 또 문이 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Pagpasok, may isa na namang pinto.
translations.ne: भित्र पस्नेबित्तिकै फेरि अर्को ढोका थियो।
translations.id: Begitu masuk, ada pintu lagi.
translations.pt: Logo ao entrar, havia outra porta.
translations.my: အထဲဝင်တာနဲ့ နောက်ထပ် တံခါး ရှိတယ်။
translations.th: พอเข้าไปข้างใน ก็มีประตูอีกบาน
translations.si: දෙන්නා ඇතුළට ගිය ගමන්ම, ආයෙත් දොරක් තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: すぐに = ngay. また = lại.
grammarNote.en: すぐに = right away. また = again.
grammarNote.my: ချက်ချင်း။ ထပ်။
grammarNote.th: ทันที อีก
grammarNote.si: すぐに = වහාම. また = ආයෙත්.

sentences.ja: 戸のうらには、こう書いてありました。
sentences.romaji: To no ura ni wa, kou kaitearimashita.

translations.vi: Mặt sau cánh cửa có ghi thế này.
translations.en: On the back of the door, this was written.
translations.zh-Hans: 门的背面写着这样的话。
translations.zh-Hant: 門的背面寫著這樣的話。
translations.ko: 문 뒤쪽에는 이렇게 쓰여 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Sa likod ng pinto ay nakasulat ito.
translations.ne: ढोकाको पछाडि यसो लेखिएको थियो।
translations.id: Di balik pintu tertulis begini.
translations.pt: No verso da porta estava escrito.
translations.th: ด้านหลังประตูเขียนไว้ว่า
translations.si: දොරේ පිටිපස්සේ මෙහෙම ලියලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: うら = mặt sau.
grammarNote.en: うら = back side.
grammarNote.th: ด้านหลัง
grammarNote.si: うら = පිටිපස්ස.

sentences.ja: 「ことに、太った方や、わかい方は、大かんげいいたします。」
sentences.romaji: “Kotoni, futotta hou ya, wakai hou wa, daikangei itashimasu.”

translations.vi: "Đặc biệt, người mập và người trẻ chúng tôi vô cùng hoan nghênh."
translations.en: "We especially welcome plump people and young people."
translations.zh-Hans: “特别欢迎胖的客人和年轻的客人。”
translations.zh-Hant: “特別歡迎胖的客人和年輕的客人。”
translations.ko: "특히 살찐 분이나 젊은 분은 대환영입니다."
translations.tl: "Lalo naming tinatanggap ang matataba at mga bata pa."
translations.ne: "विशेषगरी मोटा र युवाहरूलाई हार्दिक स्वागत छ।"
translations.id: "Terutama yang gemuk dan yang muda, sangat disambut."
translations.pt: "Gordinhos e jovens são especialmente bem-vindos."
translations.my: "အထူးသဖြင့် ဝသူနဲ့ ငယ်သူကို အထူး ကြိုဆိုပါတယ်။"
translations.th: "โดยเฉพาะคนอ้วนและคนหนุ่มสาว ยินดีต้อนรับเป็นพิเศษ"
translations.si: "විශේෂයෙන්ම මහත අයටයි තරුණ අයටයි උණුසුම් පිළිගැනීමක්."

grammarNote.vi: ことに = đặc biệt là. 大かんげい = rất hoan nghênh.
grammarNote.en: ことに = especially. 大かんげい = big welcome.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: ことに＝尤其。大かんげい＝非常欢迎。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: ことに＝尤其。大かんげい＝非常歡迎。
grammarNote.th: โดยเฉพาะ ยินดีอย่างยิ่ง
grammarNote.si: ことに = විශේෂයෙන්ම. 大かんげい = උණුසුම් පිළිගැනීම.

sentences.ja: 「ぼくらは、両方だ。大かんげいだってさ。」
sentences.romaji: “Bokura wa, ryouhou da. Daikangei datte sa.”

translations.vi: "Bọn mình là cả hai. Được hoan nghênh đấy."
translations.en: "We're both! A big welcome for us."
translations.zh-Hans: “我们俩两样都占。说是非常欢迎呢。”
translations.zh-Hant: “我們倆兩樣都佔。說是非常歡迎呢。”
translations.ko: "우리는 둘 다야. 대환영이래."
translations.tl: "Pareho tayo! Malugod daw tayong tinatanggap."
translations.ne: "हामी त दुवै हौँ। हार्दिक स्वागत रे।"
translations.id: "Kita dua-duanya. Sangat disambut, katanya."
translations.pt: "Somos os dois! Muito bem-vindos, diz aqui."
translations.th: "พวกเราเป็นทั้งสองอย่าง ยินดีต้อนรับสุด ๆ เลย"
translations.si: "අපි දෙකම! අපිට උණුසුම් පිළිගැනීමක් ලු."

grammarNote.vi: 両方 = cả hai. 〜ってさ = nghe nói ~ đấy.
grammarNote.en: 両方 = both. 〜ってさ = they say ~.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 両方＝两者都。〜ってさ＝据说……呢。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 両方＝兩者都。〜ってさ＝據說……呢。
grammarNote.th: ทั้งสอง เขาว่า ~
grammarNote.si: 両方 = දෙකම. 〜ってさ = ~ ලු.

sentences.ja: 二人はうれしくなって、ろうかを進みました。

furigana.surface: はうれしくなって、ろうかを

sentences.romaji: Futari wa ureshiku natte, rouka o susumimashita.

translations.vi: Hai người hớn hở đi tiếp dọc hành lang.
translations.en: Delighted, the two went down the corridor.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人高兴地沿着走廊往前走。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人高興地沿著走廊往前走。
translations.ko: 두 사람은 기뻐하며 복도를 나아갔습니다.
translations.tl: Masaya silang naglakad sa pasilyo.
translations.ne: दुवै खुसी हुँदै बरन्डामा अघि बढे।
translations.id: Keduanya senang dan menyusuri lorong.
translations.pt: Contentes, seguiram pelo corredor.
translations.my: နှစ်ယောက်လုံး ဝမ်းသာပြီး စင်္ကြံအတိုင်း ဆက်သွားတယ်။
translations.th: สองคนดีใจ เดินไปตามทางเดิน
translations.si: දෙන්නා සතුටු වෙලා, කොරිඩෝව දිගේ ඉස්සරහට ගියා.

grammarNote.vi: ろうか = hành lang. 進む = tiến lên.
grammarNote.en: ろうか = corridor. 進む = advance.
grammarNote.th: ทางเดิน ก้าวไป
grammarNote.si: ろうか = කොරිඩෝව. 進む = ඉදිරියට යනවා.

sentences.ja: すると、今度は、水色のペンキの戸がありました。
sentences.romaji: Suruto, kondo wa, mizuiro no penki no to ga arimashita.

translations.vi: Lần này là một cánh cửa sơn màu xanh nhạt.
translations.en: This time, there was a door painted light blue.
translations.zh-Hans: 这次是一扇刷着浅蓝色油漆的门。
translations.zh-Hant: 這次是一扇刷著淺藍色油漆的門。
translations.ko: 이번에는 하늘색 페인트 문이 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Ngayon, may pintong pinintahan ng mapusyaw na asul.
translations.ne: यसपटक हल्का नीलो रङ लगाएको ढोका थियो।
translations.id: Kali ini ada pintu bercat biru muda.
translations.pt: Desta vez, uma porta pintada de azul-claro.
translations.my: ဒီတစ်ခါ အပြာနုရောင် ဆေးသုတ်တံခါး ရှိတယ်။
translations.th: คราวนี้เป็นประตูทาสีฟ้าอ่อน
translations.si: එතකොට, මේ පාර ලා නිල් පාට තීන්ත ගාපු දොරක් තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 今度 = lần này. 水色 = xanh nhạt.
grammarNote.en: 今度 = this time. 水色 = light blue.
grammarNote.my: ဒီတစ်ခါ။ အပြာနု။
grammarNote.th: คราวนี้ สีฟ้าอ่อน
grammarNote.si: 今度 = මේ පාර. 水色 = ලා නිල්.

sentences.ja: 「当店は、注文の多い料理店ですから、どうか、そこはご承知ください。」

furigana.surface: ですから、どうか、そこはご

sentences.romaji: “Touten wa, chuumon no ooi ryouriten desu kara, dou ka, soko wa goshouchi kudasai.”

translations.vi: "Quán chúng tôi là nhà hàng lắm yêu cầu, xin quý khách thông cảm cho."
translations.en: "This is a restaurant with many orders, so please understand."
translations.zh-Hans: “本店是要求很多的餐馆，请您谅解。”
translations.zh-Hant: “本店是要求很多的餐館，請您諒解。”
translations.ko: "저희 가게는 주문이 많은 요리점이니 부디 양해해 주십시오."
translations.tl: "Maraming hinihiling ang kainang ito, kaya sana'y maunawaan ninyo."
translations.ne: "हाम्रो पसल धेरै अर्डर हुने भोजनालय हो, कृपया बुझिदिनुहोस्।"
translations.id: "Toko kami restoran yang banyak pesanannya, mohon dimaklumi."
translations.pt: "Este é um restaurante de muitos pedidos; por favor, compreendam."
translations.th: "ร้านของเราเป็นร้านที่มีคำสั่งมาก โปรดเข้าใจด้วย"
translations.si: "අපේ අවන්හල ඕඩර් ගොඩක් තියෙන අවන්හලක් නිසා, කරුණාකර ඒක තේරුම් ගන්න."

grammarNote.vi: 注文 = yêu cầu / gọi món (chữ chơi hai nghĩa). ご承知ください = xin hiểu cho.
grammarNote.en: 注文 = order / request (wordplay). ご承知ください = please understand.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 注文＝点菜／要求（双关）。ご承知ください＝请谅解。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 註文＝點菜／要求（雙關）。ご承知ください＝請諒解。
grammarNote.my: မှာစရာ (နှစ်မျိုးအဓိပ္ပာယ်)။ နားလည်ပေးပါ။
grammarNote.th: คำสั่ง (เล่นคำสองความหมาย) โปรดเข้าใจ
grammarNote.si: 注文 = ඇණවුම / ඉල්ලීම (ද්විත්ව අර්ථය). ご承知ください = කරුණාකර තේරුම් ගන්න.

sentences.ja: 「注文が多いって、どういうことだろう。」

furigana.surface: いって、どういうことだろう。」

sentences.romaji: “Chuumon ga ooi tte, douiu koto darou.”

translations.vi: "Lắm yêu cầu là sao nhỉ?"
translations.en: "What do they mean, many orders?"
translations.zh-Hans: “要求多，是什么意思呢？”
translations.zh-Hant: “要求多，是什麼意思呢？”
translations.ko: "주문이 많다니, 무슨 뜻일까?"
translations.tl: "Ano kaya ang ibig sabihin ng maraming order?"
translations.ne: "धेरै अर्डर भनेको के होला?"
translations.id: "Banyak pesanan, maksudnya apa ya?"
translations.pt: "Muitos pedidos? O que será isso?"
translations.my: "မှာစရာများတယ်ဆိုတာ ဘာလဲ မသိဘူး။"
translations.th: "คำสั่งเยอะนี่หมายความว่าไงนะ"
translations.si: "ඕඩර් ගොඩක් කියන්නේ මොකක්ද?"

grammarNote.vi: どういうこと = nghĩa là sao.
grammarNote.en: どういうこと = what does it mean.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: どういうこと＝什么意思。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: どういうこと＝什麼意思。
grammarNote.my: ဘာအဓိပ္ပာယ်လဲ။
grammarNote.th: หมายความว่าอะไร
grammarNote.si: どういうこと = මොකක්ද අදහස.

sentences.ja: 「人気がある店だから、注文がたくさん来るってことさ。」
sentences.romaji: “Ninki ga aru mise da kara, chuumon ga takusan kuru tte koto sa.”

translations.vi: "Quán đông khách nên có nhiều người gọi món chứ gì."
translations.en: "It's a popular place, so lots of orders come in, that's all."
translations.zh-Hans: “是生意好的店，所以点菜的人多呗。”
translations.zh-Hant: “是生意好的店，所以點菜的人多唄。”
translations.ko: "인기 있는 가게라서 주문이 많이 들어온다는 거지."
translations.tl: "Sikat ang lugar kaya maraming order, iyon lang."
translations.ne: "चल्तीको पसल भएकाले धेरै अर्डर आउँछ भन्ने हो।"
translations.id: "Restorannya laris, jadi banyak pesanan, begitu."
translations.pt: "É um lugar famoso, por isso tem muitos pedidos."
translations.th: "ร้านดัง คนสั่งเยอะไงล่ะ"
translations.si: "ජනප්‍රිය කඩයක් නිසා, ඕඩර් ගොඩක් එනවා කියන එක, එච්චරයි."

grammarNote.vi: 人気 = được ưa chuộng. 〜ってこと = nghĩa là ~.
grammarNote.en: 人気 = popularity. 〜ってこと = it means ~.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 人気＝受欢迎。〜ってこと＝就是说……。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 人気＝受歡迎。〜ってこと＝就是說……。
grammarNote.th: นิยม หมายความว่า
grammarNote.si: 人気 = ජනප්‍රියතාව. 〜ってこと = ~ කියන එක.

sentences.ja: 次の戸には、こう書いてありました。
sentences.romaji: Tsugi no to ni wa, kou kaitearimashita.

translations.vi: Cánh cửa tiếp theo ghi thế này.
translations.en: The next door said this.
translations.zh-Hans: 下一扇门上这样写着。
translations.zh-Hant: 下一扇門上這樣寫著。
translations.ko: 다음 문에는 이렇게 쓰여 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Ganito ang nakasulat sa susunod na pinto.
translations.ne: अर्को ढोकामा यसो लेखिएको थियो।
translations.id: Di pintu berikutnya tertulis begini.
translations.pt: Na porta seguinte estava escrito.
translations.th: ประตูถัดไปเขียนว่า
translations.si: ඊළඟ දොරේ මෙහෙම ලියලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 次の = tiếp theo.
grammarNote.en: 次の = next.
grammarNote.th: ถัดไป
grammarNote.si: 次の = ඊළඟ.

sentences.ja: 「注文はずいぶん多いでしょうが、どうか、いちいち、こらえてください。」

furigana.surface: いでしょうが、どうか、いちいち、こらえてください。」

sentences.romaji: “Chuumon wa zuibun ooideshou ga, dou ka, ichiichi, koraetekudasai.”

translations.vi: "Yêu cầu chắc là khá nhiều, nhưng xin quý khách kiên nhẫn từng điều một."
translations.en: "There may be quite a few orders, but please bear with each one."
translations.zh-Hans: “要求恐怕很多，请您一一忍耐。”
translations.zh-Hant: “要求恐怕很多，請您一一忍耐。”
translations.ko: "주문이 꽤 많겠지만 부디 하나하나 참아 주십시오."
translations.tl: "Marami man ang hiling, pagtiisan po ninyo isa-isa."
translations.ne: "अर्डर धेरै होला, तर कृपया एक-एक सहनुहोस्।"
translations.id: "Pesanannya mungkin banyak, tapi mohon bersabar satu per satu."
translations.pt: "Os pedidos são muitos, mas tenham paciência com cada um."
translations.th: "คำสั่งคงเยอะ แต่โปรดอดทนทีละข้อ"
translations.si: "ඕඩර් ගොඩක් වෙන්න පුළුවන්, ඒත් කරුණාකර එකින් එක ඉවසගන්න."

meanings.my: တစ်ခုချင်း

grammarNote.vi: こらえる = nhẫn nhịn. ずいぶん = khá là.
grammarNote.en: こらえる = endure. ずいぶん = quite.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: こらえる＝忍耐。ずいぶん＝相当。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: こらえる＝忍耐。ずいぶん＝相當。
grammarNote.th: อดทน ค่อนข้าง
grammarNote.si: こらえる = ඉවසනවා. ずいぶん = ගොඩක්.

sentences.ja: そばには、鏡と、長いブラシがおいてありました。

furigana.surface: いブラシがおいてありました。

sentences.romaji: Soba ni wa, kagami to, nagai burashi ga oitearimashita.

translations.vi: Bên cạnh có đặt một chiếc gương và cây bàn chải dài.
translations.en: Beside it lay a mirror and a long brush.
translations.zh-Hans: 旁边放着镜子和长刷子。
translations.zh-Hant: 旁邊放著鏡子和長刷子。
translations.ko: 옆에는 거울과 긴 솔이 놓여 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Sa tabi ay may salamin at mahabang brush.
translations.ne: छेउमा ऐना र लामो ब्रस राखिएको थियो।
translations.id: Di sampingnya ada cermin dan sikat panjang.
translations.pt: Ao lado havia um espelho e uma escova longa.
translations.my: ဘေးမှာ မှန်နဲ့ ဘရပ်ရှ် ရှည် ထားတယ်။
translations.th: ข้าง ๆ มีกระจกกับแปรงยาววางอยู่
translations.si: ළඟ කණ්ණාඩියකුයි දිග බුරුසුවකුයි තියලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 鏡 = gương.
grammarNote.en: 鏡 = mirror.
grammarNote.th: กระจก
grammarNote.si: 鏡 = කණ්ණාඩිය.

sentences.ja: 戸には、赤い字で、こう書いてあります。
sentences.romaji: To ni wa, akai ji de, kou kaitearimasu.

translations.vi: Trên cửa ghi bằng chữ đỏ thế này.
translations.en: On the door, in red letters, it said this.
translations.zh-Hans: 门上用红字写着。
translations.zh-Hant: 門上用紅字寫著。
translations.ko: 문에는 빨간 글씨로 이렇게 쓰여 있습니다.
translations.tl: Sa pinto, nakasulat sa pulang letra.
translations.ne: ढोकामा रातो अक्षरले यसो लेखिएको छ।
translations.id: Di pintu tertulis dengan huruf merah.
translations.pt: Na porta, em letras vermelhas, dizia.
translations.my: တံခါးမှာ အနီရောင် စာနဲ့ ရေးထားတယ်။
translations.th: ที่ประตูเขียนด้วยตัวอักษรสีแดงว่า
translations.si: දොරේ රතු අකුරෙන් මෙහෙම ලියලා තියෙනවා.

grammarNote.vi: 字 = chữ.
grammarNote.en: 字 = letters.
grammarNote.th: ตัวอักษร
grammarNote.si: 字 = අකුරු.

sentences.ja: 「お客さま、ここで、かみをきちんとして、くつのどろを落としてください。」

furigana.surface: さま、ここで、かみをきちんとして、くつのどろを

sentences.romaji: “Okyakusama, koko de, kami o kichinto shite, kutsu no doro o otoshitekudasai.”

translations.vi: "Thưa quý khách, xin hãy chải tóc gọn gàng và gạt bùn ở giày tại đây."
translations.en: "Dear guests, please tidy your hair and knock the mud off your shoes here."
translations.zh-Hans: “客人，请在这里整理好头发，弄掉鞋上的泥。”
translations.zh-Hant: “客人，請在這裡整理好頭髮，弄掉鞋上的泥。”
translations.ko: "손님, 여기서 머리를 단정히 하고 신발의 진흙을 털어 주십시오."
translations.tl: "Mga panauhin, ayusin po ang buhok at alisin ang putik sa sapatos dito."
translations.ne: "पाहुना, यहाँ कपाल मिलाउनुहोस् र जुत्ताको हिलो झार्नुहोस्।"
translations.id: "Tamu yang terhormat, rapikan rambut dan bersihkan lumpur sepatu di sini."
translations.pt: "Prezados, arrumem o cabelo e tirem a lama dos sapatos aqui."
translations.my: "ဧည့်သည်တော်၊ ဒီမှာ ဆံပင် သေသပ်အောင်လုပ်ပြီး ဖိနပ်က ရွှံ့ ဖယ်ပါ။"
translations.th: "เรียนแขก โปรดหวีผมให้เรียบร้อยและปัดโคลนที่รองเท้าที่นี่"
translations.si: "ගරු අමුත්තනි, මෙතනදී කොණ්ඩේ පිළිවෙළට හදාගෙන, සපත්තුවල මඩ අයින් කරන්න."

meanings.my: သေသေသပ်သပ်
meanings.th: อย่างเรียบร้อย

grammarNote.vi: きちんと = gọn gàng. どろ = bùn.
grammarNote.en: きちんと = neatly. どろ = mud.
grammarNote.th: เรียบร้อย โคลน
grammarNote.si: きちんと = පිළිවෙළට. どろ = මඩ.

sentences.ja: 「なるほど、きちんとした店だ。えらい人が、たくさん来るんだろう。」
sentences.romaji: “Naruhodo, kichinto shita mise da. Erai hito ga, takusan kuru n darou.”

translations.vi: "Ra thế, quán đâu ra đấy. Chắc nhiều nhân vật lớn hay đến lắm."
translations.en: "I see—a proper place. Lots of important people must come here."
translations.zh-Hans: “原来如此，是家讲究的店。一定有很多大人物来吧。”
translations.zh-Hant: “原來如此，是家講究的店。一定有很多大人物來吧。”
translations.ko: "과연 제대로 된 가게군. 높은 사람들이 많이 오나 봐."
translations.tl: "Ah, maayos na lugar. Siguro maraming mahalagang tao ang pumupunta."
translations.ne: "ठीक, राम्रो पसल रहेछ। ठूला मान्छे धेरै आउँछन् होला।"
translations.id: "Pantas, restoran yang rapi. Pasti banyak orang penting datang."
translations.pt: "Ah, é um lugar fino. Deve vir muita gente importante."
translations.th: "อย่างนี้นี่เอง ร้านเรียบร้อยดี คงมีคนใหญ่คนโตมาเยอะ"
translations.si: "හරි, පිළිවෙළ කඩයක්. ලොකු ලොකු අය ගොඩක් එනවා ඇති."

grammarNote.vi: なるほど = ra thế. えらい人 = người có địa vị.
grammarNote.en: なるほど = I see. えらい人 = important person.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: なるほど＝原来如此。えらい人＝大人物。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: なるほど＝原來如此。えらい人＝大人物。
grammarNote.th: อย่างนี้นี่เอง คนใหญ่คนโต
grammarNote.si: なるほど = හරි, තේරුණා. えらい人 = වැදගත් පුද්ගලයා.

sentences.ja: 二人は、かみをきれいにとかして、くつのどろを落としました。

furigana.surface: は、かみをきれいにとかして、くつのどろを

sentences.romaji: Futari wa, kami o kirei ni tokashite, kutsu no doro o otoshimashita.

translations.vi: Hai người chải tóc thật đẹp, gạt bùn ở giày.
translations.en: The two neatly combed their hair and cleaned the mud off their shoes.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人把头发梳得整整齐齐，弄掉了鞋上的泥。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人把頭髮梳得整整齊齊，弄掉了鞋上的泥。
translations.ko: 두 사람은 머리를 깔끔하게 빗고 신발의 진흙을 털었습니다.
translations.tl: Sinuklay nila nang maayos ang buhok at nilinis ang sapatos.
translations.ne: दुवैले कपाल राम्ररी कोरे र जुत्ताको हिलो झारे।
translations.id: Keduanya menyisir rambut rapi dan membersihkan lumpur sepatu.
translations.pt: Os dois pentearam o cabelo e limparam a lama dos sapatos.
translations.my: နှစ်ယောက်လုံး ဆံပင် ဖြီးပြီး ဖိနပ်က ရွှံ့ ဖယ်တယ်။
translations.th: สองคนหวีผมเรียบร้อย ปัดโคลนที่รองเท้า
translations.si: දෙන්නා කොණ්ඩේ ලස්සනට පීරලා, සපත්තුවල මඩ අයින් කළා.

grammarNote.vi: とかす = chải (tóc).
grammarNote.en: とかす = comb.
grammarNote.th: หวี
grammarNote.si: とかす = පීරනවා.

sentences.ja: すると、ブラシが、すうっと消えてしまいました。

furigana.surface: すると、ブラシが、すうっと

sentences.romaji: Suruto, burashi ga, suutto kieteshimaimashita.

translations.vi: Thế rồi, cây bàn chải lặng lẽ biến mất.
translations.en: Then, the brush quietly vanished.
translations.zh-Hans: 这时，刷子悄悄地消失了。
translations.zh-Hant: 這時，刷子悄悄地消失了。
translations.ko: 그러자 솔이 스르르 사라져 버렸습니다.
translations.tl: At biglang naglaho ang brush.
translations.ne: अनि ब्रस सुटुक्क हरायो।
translations.id: Lalu sikat itu lenyap perlahan.
translations.pt: Então a escova sumiu devagarinho.
translations.my: ဒီတော့ ဘရပ်ရှ်က ငြိမ်ငြိမ်လေး ပျောက်သွားတယ်။
translations.th: แล้วแปรงก็หายวับไปเงียบ ๆ
translations.si: එතකොට, බුරුසුව නිශ්ශබ්දව නැතිවෙලා ගියා.

grammarNote.vi: 消える = biến mất.
grammarNote.en: 消える = vanish.
grammarNote.th: หายไป
grammarNote.si: 消える = නැති වෙනවා.

sentences.ja: 次の戸には、こう書いてありました。
sentences.romaji: Tsugi no to ni wa, kou kaitearimashita.

translations.vi: Cánh cửa tiếp theo ghi thế này.
translations.en: The next door read like this.
translations.zh-Hans: 下一扇门上写着这样的话。
translations.zh-Hant: 下一扇門上寫著這樣的話。
translations.ko: 그다음 문에는 이렇게 쓰여 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Ganito naman ang nasa sumunod na pinto.
translations.ne: त्यसपछिको ढोकामा यसो लेखिएको थियो।
translations.id: Pintu berikutnya bertuliskan begini.
translations.pt: A porta seguinte dizia assim.
translations.my: နောက်တံခါးမှာ ဒီလို ရေးထားပြန်တယ်။
translations.th: ประตูถัดมาเขียนไว้ว่า
translations.si: ඊළඟ දොරේ මෙහෙම ලියලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: こう = như thế này.
grammarNote.en: こう = like this.
grammarNote.th: อย่างนี้
grammarNote.si: こう = මෙහෙම.

sentences.ja: 「鉄砲と、たまを、ここに置いてください。」
sentences.romaji: “Teppou to, tama o, koko ni oitekudasai.”

translations.vi: "Xin để súng và đạn lại đây."
translations.en: "Please leave your guns and bullets here."
translations.zh-Hans: “请把枪和子弹放在这里。”
translations.zh-Hant: “請把槍和子彈放在這裡。”
translations.ko: "총과 탄환은 여기에 놓아 주십시오."
translations.tl: "Pakilagay po rito ang baril at bala."
translations.ne: "बन्दुक र गोली यहीँ राख्नुहोस्।"
translations.id: "Silakan taruh senapan dan peluru di sini."
translations.pt: "Deixem as armas e as balas aqui."
translations.my: "သေနတ်နဲ့ ကျည်ဆံ ဒီမှာ ထားခဲ့ပါ။"
translations.th: "โปรดวางปืนและกระสุนไว้ที่นี่"
translations.si: "තුවක්කුයි උණ්ඩයි මෙතන තියන්න."

grammarNote.vi: たま = đạn. 置く = đặt.
grammarNote.en: たま = bullets. 置く = put.
grammarNote.th: กระสุน วาง
grammarNote.si: たま = උණ්ඩ. 置く = තියනවා.

sentences.ja: 「なるほど、鉄砲を持って、ものを食べる人はいないね。」
sentences.romaji: “Naruhodo, teppou o motte, mono o taberu hito wa inai ne.”

translations.vi: "Phải rồi, chẳng ai vừa cầm súng vừa ăn cả."
translations.en: "Of course, nobody eats while holding a gun."
translations.zh-Hans: “说得也是，没有人拿着枪吃饭的。”
translations.zh-Hant: “說得也是，沒有人拿著槍吃飯的。”
translations.ko: "그렇지, 총을 들고 밥 먹는 사람은 없지."
translations.tl: "Oo nga, walang kumakain na may hawak na baril."
translations.ne: "हो त, बन्दुक बोकेर खाना खाने कोही हुँदैन।"
translations.id: "Benar juga, tak ada yang makan sambil pegang senapan."
translations.pt: "Claro, ninguém come segurando uma arma."
translations.th: "จริงสิ ไม่มีใครถือปืนกินข้าวหรอก"
translations.si: "ඔව් ඉතින්, තුවක්කුවක් අල්ලගෙන කන කෙනෙක් නැහැ නේ."

grammarNote.vi: 〜て = vừa ~ (cách thức).
grammarNote.en: 〜て = while ~ (manner).
grammarNote.th: ขณะ ~
grammarNote.si: 〜て = ~ ගෙන (ආකාරය).

sentences.ja: 二人は、鉄砲とたまを、テーブルの上に置きました。
sentences.romaji: Futari wa, teppou to tama o, teeburu no ue ni okimashita.

translations.vi: Hai người đặt súng và đạn lên bàn.
translations.en: The two put their guns and bullets on the table.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人把枪和子弹放在了桌子上。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人把槍和子彈放在了桌子上。
translations.ko: 두 사람은 총과 탄환을 테이블 위에 놓았습니다.
translations.tl: Inilagay nila ang baril at bala sa mesa.
translations.ne: दुवैले बन्दुक र गोली टेबलमा राखे।
translations.id: Keduanya menaruh senapan dan peluru di meja.
translations.pt: Os dois puseram armas e balas na mesa.
translations.my: နှစ်ယောက်လုံး သေနတ်နဲ့ ကျည်ဆံကို စားပွဲပေါ် တင်တယ်။
translations.th: สองคนวางปืนกับกระสุนบนโต๊ะ
translations.si: දෙන්නා තුවක්කුයි උණ්ඩයි මේසය උඩ තිබ්බා.

grammarNote.vi: テーブル = cái bàn.
grammarNote.en: テーブル = table.
grammarNote.th: โต๊ะ
grammarNote.si: テーブル = මේසය.

sentences.ja: また、黒い戸がありました。
sentences.romaji: Mata, kuroi to ga arimashita.

translations.vi: Lại có một cánh cửa màu đen.
translations.en: Again, there was a black door.
translations.zh-Hans: 又有一扇黑色的门。
translations.zh-Hant: 又有一扇黑色的門。
translations.ko: 또 검은 문이 있었습니다.
translations.tl: May itim na pinto na naman.
translations.ne: फेरि कालो ढोका थियो।
translations.id: Ada pintu hitam lagi.
translations.pt: Havia outra porta, preta.
translations.my: နောက်ထပ် တံခါးမည်း ရှိတယ်။
translations.th: มีประตูสีดำอีก
translations.si: ආයෙත් කළු දොරක් තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 黒い = màu đen.
grammarNote.en: 黒い = black.
grammarNote.th: ดำ
grammarNote.si: 黒い = කළු.

sentences.ja: 「どうか、ぼうしと、コートと、くつを、おとりください。」

furigana.surface: 「どうか、ぼうしと、コートと、くつを、おとりください。」

sentences.romaji: “Dou ka, boushi to, kooto to, kutsu o, otorikudasai.”

translations.vi: "Xin quý khách bỏ mũ, áo khoác và giày ra."
translations.en: "Please remove your hats, coats, and shoes."
translations.zh-Hans: “请脱下帽子、外套和鞋子。”
translations.zh-Hant: “請脫下帽子、外套和鞋子。”
translations.ko: "부디 모자와 코트와 신발을 벗어 주십시오."
translations.tl: "Pakihubad po ang sombrero, amerikana, at sapatos."
translations.ne: "कृपया टोपी, कोट र जुत्ता खोल्नुहोस्।"
translations.id: "Silakan lepas topi, mantel, dan sepatu."
translations.pt: "Por favor, tirem chapéu, casaco e sapatos."
translations.th: "โปรดถอดหมวก เสื้อโค้ต และรองเท้า"
translations.si: "කරුණාකර තොප්පි, කබා, සපත්තු ගලවන්න."

grammarNote.vi: おとりください = xin hãy cởi/bỏ ra (kính ngữ).
grammarNote.en: おとりください = please remove (polite).
grammarNote.zh-Hans: おとりください＝请脱下（敬语）。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: おとりください＝請脫下（敬語）。
grammarNote.th: โปรดถอด
grammarNote.si: おとりください = කරුණාකර ගලවන්න (ගෞරවාර්ථ).

sentences.ja: 二人は、言われたとおりに、ぼうしもコートもくつも、ぬぎました。

furigana.surface: われたとおりに、ぼうしもコートもくつも、ぬぎました。

sentences.romaji: Futari wa, iwareta toori ni, boushi mo kooto mo kutsu mo, nugimashita.

translations.vi: Hai người làm đúng như được dặn, cởi mũ, áo khoác và cả giày.
translations.en: Doing as told, they took off their hats, coats, and shoes.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人照说的，脱下了帽子、外套和鞋。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人照說的，脫下了帽子、外套和鞋。
translations.ko: 두 사람은 시키는 대로 모자도 코트도 신발도 벗었습니다.
translations.tl: Gaya ng sinabi, hinubad nila ang sombrero, amerikana, at sapatos.
translations.ne: भनेजस्तै दुवैले टोपी, कोट र जुत्ता खोले।
translations.id: Sesuai perintah, mereka melepas topi, mantel, dan sepatu.
translations.pt: Como mandado, tiraram chapéu, casaco e sapatos.
translations.my: ပြောတဲ့အတိုင်း ဦးထုပ်ရော အင်္ကျီရော ဖိနပ်ရော ချွတ်တယ်။
translations.th: สองคนถอดหมวก เสื้อโค้ต และรองเท้าตามที่บอก
translations.si: දෙන්නා කිව්ව විදිහටම, තොප්පිත් කබාත් සපත්තුත් ගැලෙව්වා.

grammarNote.vi: 言われたとおりに = đúng như được bảo. ぬぐ = cởi.
grammarNote.en: 言われたとおりに = as told. ぬぐ = take off.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 言われたとおりに＝按照说的。ぬぐ＝脱。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 言われたとおりに＝按照說的。ぬぐ＝脫。
grammarNote.th: ตามที่บอก ถอด
grammarNote.si: 言われたとおりに = කිව්ව විදිහටම. ぬぐ = ගලවනවා.

sentences.ja: 戸のうらには、また何か書いてありました。
sentences.romaji: To no ura ni wa, mata nani ka kaitearimashita.

translations.vi: Mặt sau cửa lại có ghi gì đó.
translations.en: On the back of the door, something was written again.
translations.zh-Hans: 门背面又写着什么。
translations.zh-Hant: 門背面又寫著什麼。
translations.ko: 문 뒤에는 또 무언가 쓰여 있었습니다.
translations.tl: May nakasulat na naman sa likod ng pinto.
translations.ne: ढोकाको पछाडि फेरि केही लेखिएको थियो।
translations.id: Di balik pintu tertulis sesuatu lagi.
translations.pt: No verso da porta havia algo escrito de novo.
translations.my: တံခါးနောက်မှာ တစ်ခုခု ထပ်ရေးထားတယ်။
translations.th: หลังประตูเขียนอะไรไว้อีก
translations.si: දොරේ පිටිපස්සේ ආයෙත් මොකක්හරි ලියලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 何か = cái gì đó.
grammarNote.en: 何か = something.
grammarNote.th: อะไรบางอย่าง
grammarNote.si: 何か = මොකක්හරි.

sentences.ja: 「ネクタイピン、カフスボタン、めがね、さいふ、そのほか金ものは、ここに置いてください。」

furigana.surface: 「ネクタイピン、カフスボタン、めがね、さいふ、そのほか

sentences.romaji: “Nekutaipin, kafusubotan, megane, saifu, sono hoka kanamono wa, koko ni oitekudasai.”

translations.vi: "Kẹp cà vạt, khuy măng sét, kính, ví và mọi đồ kim loại khác, xin để lại đây."
translations.en: "Tie pins, cufflinks, glasses, wallets, and any other metal items: please leave them here."
translations.zh-Hans: “领带夹、袖扣、眼镜、钱包，其他金属物品，请放在这里。”
translations.zh-Hant: “領帶夾、袖釦、眼鏡、錢包，其他金屬物品，請放在這裡。”
translations.ko: "넥타이핀, 커프스단추, 안경, 지갑, 그 밖의 쇠붙이는 여기에 놓아 주십시오."
translations.tl: "Ang tie pin, cufflinks, salamin, pitaka, at iba pang metal, ilagay po rito."
translations.ne: "टाई पिन, कफलिङ्क, चस्मा, पर्स र अन्य धातुका सामान यहाँ राख्नुहोस्।"
translations.id: "Peniti dasi, kancing manset, kacamata, dompet, dan logam lain, taruh di sini."
translations.pt: "Prendedores, abotoaduras, óculos, carteiras e outros metais, deixem aqui."
translations.my: "နက်ကတိုင်ညှပ်၊ ကြယ်သီး၊ မျက်မှန်၊ ပိုက်ဆံအိတ်နဲ့ သတ္တုပစ္စည်းတွေ ဒီမှာ ထားခဲ့ပါ။"
translations.th: "เข็มกลัดเนกไท กระดุมข้อมือ แว่นตา กระเป๋าสตางค์ และของโลหะอื่น ๆ โปรดวางไว้ที่นี่"
translations.si: "ටයි පින්, කෆ්ලින්ක්ස්, කණ්ණාඩි, පසුම්බි, වෙනත් ලෝහ බඩු මෙතන තියන්න."

grammarNote.vi: 金もの = đồ kim loại. そのほか = ngoài ra.
grammarNote.en: 金もの = metal items. そのほか = other.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 金もの＝金属物品。そのほか＝其他。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 金もの＝金屬物品。そのほか＝其他。
grammarNote.my: သတ္တုပစ္စည်း။ အခြား။
grammarNote.th: ของโลหะ อื่น ๆ
grammarNote.si: 金もの = ලෝහ බඩු. そのほか = වෙනත්.

sentences.ja: 「料理に電気を使うんだな。金ものは、あぶないからだろう。」

furigana.surface: ものは、あぶないからだろう。」

sentences.romaji: “Ryouri ni denki o tsukau n da na. Kanamono wa, abunai kara darou.”

translations.vi: "Chắc nấu nướng dùng điện. Đồ kim loại thì nguy hiểm mà."
translations.en: "They must cook with electricity. Metal would be dangerous."
translations.zh-Hans: “做菜要用电吧。金属很危险嘛。”
translations.zh-Hant: “做菜要用電吧。金屬很危險嘛。”
translations.ko: "요리에 전기를 쓰는군. 쇠붙이는 위험하니까."
translations.tl: "Kuryente siguro ang gamit sa pagluluto. Delikado ang metal."
translations.ne: "खाना पकाउन बिजुली चलाउँछन् होला। धातु खतरनाक हुन्छ।"
translations.id: "Pasti masaknya pakai listrik. Logam berbahaya."
translations.pt: "Devem cozinhar com eletricidade. Metal é perigoso."
translations.my: "ဟင်းချက်ရင် လျှပ်စစ် သုံးမှာ။ သတ္တုက အန္တရာယ်ရှိလို့။"
translations.th: "คงใช้ไฟฟ้าทำอาหาร ของโลหะอันตรายนี่"
translations.si: "කෑම හදන්න විදුලිය පාවිච්චි කරනවා ඇති. ලෝහ බඩු භයානක නිසා වෙන්න ඇති."

grammarNote.vi: 〜んだな = thì ra là ~. 電気 = điện.
grammarNote.en: 〜んだな = so it's ~. 電気 = electricity.
grammarNote.th: ที่แท้ ~ ไฟฟ้า
grammarNote.si: 〜んだな = ~ නේද එහෙනම්. 電気 = විදුලිය.

sentences.ja: 二人は、めがねも、さいふも、みんな金庫の中に入れて、かぎをかけました。

furigana.surface: は、めがねも、さいふも、みんな
れて、かぎをかけました。

sentences.romaji: Futari wa, megane mo, saifu mo, minna kinko no naka ni irete, kagi o kakemashita.

translations.en: They put their glasses and wallets into a safe and locked it.

translations.ko: 두 사람은 안경도 지갑도 모두 금고 안에 넣고 자물쇠를 잠갔습니다.
translations.tl: Inilagay nila ang salamin at pitaka sa kaha de yero at ikinandado.
translations.ne: दुवैले चस्मा र पर्स सबै तिजोरीमा राखेर ताल्चा लगाए।
translations.id: Keduanya memasukkan kacamata dan dompet ke brankas lalu menguncinya.
translations.pt: Puseram óculos e carteiras no cofre e trancaram.
translations.my: မျက်မှန်ရော ပိုက်ဆံအိတ်ရော မီးခံသေတ္တာထဲ ထည့်ပြီး သော့ခတ်တယ်။
translations.th: สองคนใส่แว่นและกระเป๋าสตางค์ลงในตู้เซฟ แล้วล็อกไว้
translations.si: දෙන්නා කණ්ණාඩියි පසුම්බියි ඔක්කොම සේප්පුවට දාලා, යතුරු දැම්මා.
